signature.likely_cause: Driver-side GCS LIST timed out during input discovery - usually a glob the GCS connector resolves by flat-listing the entire prefix (O(all history)) before filtering. Retries die at a ~constant elapsed (same execution point). 'Lost executor ... spark scale down' lines alongside are benign idle decommissions, NOT the cause. A re-run usually passes (list latency is variable); durable fix is literal partition paths instead of a glob, or fs.gs.glob.flat.enable=false. The evidence lives in the staging-bucket driveroutput, not the Airflow log.

from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Tuple
import pendulum
import random

from airflow import DAG
from airflow.decorators import task
from airflow.models import Variable
from airflow.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.operators.trigger_dagrun import TriggerDagRunOperator
from airflow.utils.email import send_email
from airflow.utils.trigger_rule import TriggerRule
from airflow.providers.google.cloud.operators.dataproc import DataprocCreateBatchOperator
from include.job_config import JobTeamConfig

TEAM = JobTeamConfig.TGT.value
ENV = Variable.get("ENV")  # e.g. dev / prod
GCP_PROJECT = f"mntn-prj-{ENV}-00"
GCP_REGION = "us-central1"
GCS_BUCKET = Variable.get("ARCHIVE_GCS_BUCKET")
# GCP_PREFIX = "tgt_test"
PYSPARK_URI = f"gs://{Variable.get('ARCHIVE_GCS_BUCKET')}/ti_resources/spark/fpa"
GCP_CONN_ID = "google_cloud_default"

ENABLED_DSIDS = [23, 25, 26, 28, 30, 36]

DSID_CONFIG = {
    23: {"script": "dsid23_guid_log_processing.py", "task_suffix": "guid_log_processing"},
    25: {"script": "dsid25_5x5_processing.py", "task_suffix": "5x5_processing"},
    26: {"script": "dsid26_predactiv_processing.py", "task_suffix": "predactiv_processing"},
    28: {"script": "dsid28_33across_processing.py", "task_suffix": "33across_processing"},
    30: {"script": "dsid30_augmentor_log_processing.py", "task_suffix": "augmentor_log_processing"},
    36: {"script": "dsid36_cybba_processing.py", "task_suffix": "cybba_processing"},
}

DSID_LAG_HOURS: Dict[int, int] = {
    23: 1,   # guid_log
    25: 5,   # 5x5
    26: 2,   # predactiv
    28: 8,   # 33across
    30: 1,   # augmentor_log
    36: 2,   # cybba
}

DP_RUNTIME = {"version": "2.3"}
# DP_ENV_EXEC = {
#     "service_account": f"airflow-ti-{ENV}@mntn-prj-{ENV}-00.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
#     "subnetwork_uri": f"projects/mntn-host-ntwrk-nonprod-00/regions/us-central1/"
#                       f"subnetworks/mntn-{ENV}-prj-snet-central1",
#     "network_tags": [f"dataproc-{ENV}"],
# }


def source_prefixes_for_partition(dsid: str, dt: str, hh: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    """
    Return GCS bucket/prefix pairs that should contain source files for a vendor partition.
    Missing source data is expected for some hourly vendor drops, so the DAG checks these
    prefixes before launching Dataproc.
    """
    yyyy, mm, dd = dt[:4], dt[5:7], dt[8:10]

    if dsid == "23":
        return [("mntn-data-archive-prod", f"guid_log/dt={dt}/hh={hh}/")]
    if dsid == "25":
        return [("mntn-data-partners", f"partners/5x5/ip_to_url/y={yyyy}/m={mm}/d={dd}/h={hh}/")]
    if dsid == "26":
        return [("mntn-data-partners", f"partners/predactiv/dt={dt.replace('-', '')}{hh}/")]
    if dsid == "28":
        return [("mntn-data-partners", f"partners/33across/{dt}-{hh}/")]
    if dsid == "30":
        return [
            ("mntn-data-archive-prod", f"augmentor_log/region=east/dt={dt}/hh={hh}/"),
            ("mntn-data-archive-prod", f"augmentor_log/region=west/dt={dt}/hh={hh}/"),
        ]
    if dsid == "36":
        return [("mntn-data-partners", f"partners/cybba/date={dt}/hour={hh}/")]

    raise ValueError(f"Missing source prefix config for dsid={dsid}")


def task_failure_notification(context: Any) -> None:
    task_instance = context["task_instance"]
    task_id = task_instance.task_id
    dag_id = task_instance.dag_id
    logical_date = context.get("logical_date")
    exception_msg = str(context.get("exception", "No exception message found"))

    subject = f"[Airflow] Task Failed: {dag_id}.{task_id}"
    body = (
        f"Task {task_id} in DAG {dag_id} failed on {logical_date}.\n\n"
        f"Error:\n{exception_msg}"
    )
    send_email("syang@mountain.com", subject, body)


with DAG(
    dag_id="fpa_site_visit_batch_serverless",
    start_date=pendulum.datetime(2025, 1, 1, tz="UTC"),
    description="Ingest FPA data to fpa_vendor_log and site_visit_signal with vendor-specific lag",
    schedule= "@hourly",
    catchup=False,
    **TEAM.make_dag_args(
        severity=1,
        tags=["targeting", "fpa", "ddp", "site_visit_signal"],
        default_args={"retries": 1}
    ),
) as dag:

    @task
    def get_dt_hh_by_dsid() -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
        """
        Return a mapping {dsid: {"dt": "YYYY-MM-DD", "hh": "HH"}}
        using vendor-specific lag hours.
        """
        from airflow.sdk import get_current_context
        ctx = get_current_context()
        dsi = ctx["data_interval_start"]

        out: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
        for dsid, lag in DSID_LAG_HOURS.items():
            t = dsi.add(hours=-lag)
            out[str(dsid)] = {"dt": t.to_date_string(), "hh": t.format("HH")}
        return out

    @task
    def build_partitions(run_params: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
        """
        Flatten run_params into a list of {dsid, dt, hh} dicts for triggering populate DAG.
        """
        parts: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
        for dsid, v in run_params.items():
            parts.append({"dsid": dsid, "dt": v["dt"], "hh": v["hh"]})
        return parts

    @task.short_circuit(ignore_downstream_trigger_rules=False, retries=2)
    def source_partition_exists(dsid: str, partition: Dict[str, str]) -> bool:
        """
        Return True when the expected source partition has at least one object.
        Returning False marks the downstream Dataproc task as skipped, which keeps
        normal vendor non-delivery from surfacing as an Airflow failure alert.
        """
        from airflow.providers.google.cloud.hooks.gcs import GCSHook

        dt = partition["dt"]
        hh = partition["hh"]
        client = GCSHook(gcp_conn_id=GCP_CONN_ID).get_conn()

        for bucket, prefix in source_prefixes_for_partition(dsid, dt, hh):
            print(f"[INFO] Checking source prefix gs://{bucket}/{prefix}")
            blobs = client.list_blobs(bucket, prefix=prefix, max_results=10)
            if any(not blob.name.endswith("/") for blob in blobs):
                print(f"[INFO] Found source data for dsid={dsid}, dt={dt}, hh={hh}")
                return True

        print(f"[INFO] No source data for dsid={dsid}, dt={dt}, hh={hh}; skipping Dataproc batch")
        return False

    # Build Dataproc tasks
    processing_tasks: List = []
    TASK_ID_BY_DSID = {}  # <— add this to map dsid -> task_id
    run_params = get_dt_hh_by_dsid()

    for dsid in ENABLED_DSIDS:
        cfg = DSID_CONFIG[dsid]
        dsid_str = str(dsid)
        source_available = source_partition_exists.override(
            task_id=f"source_available_dsid{dsid}"
        )(dsid_str, run_params[dsid_str])

        t = DataprocCreateBatchOperator(
            task_id=f"dsid{dsid}_{cfg['task_suffix']}",
            project_id=GCP_PROJECT,
            region=GCP_REGION,
            gcp_conn_id=GCP_CONN_ID,
            batch_id=(
                f"fpa-dsid{dsid}-{{{{ ds_nodash }}}}-{{{{ ts_nodash|lower }}}}-{random.randint(1000,9999)}"
            ),
            batch={
                "pyspark_batch": {
                    "main_python_file_uri": f"{PYSPARK_URI}/{cfg['script']}",
                    "args": [
                        "{{ ti.xcom_pull(task_ids='get_dt_hh_by_dsid')['" + dsid_str + "']['dt'] }}",
                        "{{ ti.xcom_pull(task_ids='get_dt_hh_by_dsid')['" + dsid_str + "']['hh'] }}",
                        ENV,
                    ],
                    "python_file_uris": [
                        "gs://mntn-data-archive-prod/ti_resources_v2/main/utils_model.zip",
                        "gs://mntn-data-archive-prod/libs/ulid.zip",
                    ],
                },
                "runtime_config": {
                    "version": DP_RUNTIME["version"],
                    "properties": {
                        "spark.jars": (
                            f"gs://{GCS_BUCKET}/ti_resources/spark/drivers/postgresql-42.6.0.jar"
                        ),
                    },
                },
                "environment_config": {
                    "execution_config": {
                        "service_account": Variable.get('DATAPROC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT'),
                        "subnetwork_uri": Variable.get('DATAPROC_SUBNET'),
                        "network_tags": [Variable.get('DATAPROC_FIREWALL_TAG')],
                    },
                },
                "labels": {"team": "ti", "env": ENV, "dsid": dsid_str, "stage": "process"},
            },
            # KEY: push XCom only when task succeeds. We'll use this to detect success.
            do_xcom_push=True,
        )
        source_available >> t
        processing_tasks.append(t)
        TASK_ID_BY_DSID[dsid_str] = t.task_id

    # Let the DAG advance even if some batches fail
    all_batches_done = EmptyOperator(
        task_id="all_batches_done",
        trigger_rule=TriggerRule.ALL_DONE,    # <— was ALL_SUCCESS
    )

    @task(trigger_rule=TriggerRule.ALL_DONE)
    def filter_successful_partitions(partitions: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
        """
        Keep only partitions whose corresponding Dataproc task completed successfully.
        We determine success by the presence of an XCom from that task (since do_xcom_push=True).
        """
        from airflow.sdk import get_current_context
        ctx = get_current_context()
        ti = ctx["ti"]

        working: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
        for p in partitions:
            dsid = p["dsid"]
            task_id = TASK_ID_BY_DSID.get(dsid)
            if not task_id:
                continue
            # If the Dataproc task succeeded, it pushed a return value to XCom.
            result = ti.xcom_pull(task_ids=task_id)
            if result is not None:
                working.append(p)
        return working

    partitions = build_partitions(run_params)

    #     wait_for_completion=False,
    # )

    end = EmptyOperator(task_id="end")

    run_params >> processing_tasks >> all_batches_done
    run_params >> partitions
    # all_batches_done >> filtered >> trigger_populate_bq >> end
    all_batches_done >> end
